conf.description: syslog-relay/syslog-ng-stats api-pull: parses the syslog-ng-ctl stats semicolon table (one counter per line, type;id;instance;state;counter;value), splits instance by object type, clamps the queued defect, and routes each counter into a typed syslog_ng.stats field before renaming the raw columns.

conf.comment: syslog-ng-ctl stats / syslog-ng-ctl query output, one counter line per event: type;id;instance;state;counter;value. No syslog header - collector-stamped host/time are not named by the map, so _time and host.name are left to the source default (see README gap).

functions.description: document source shape and the collector-timestamp gap up front
split the semicolon-delimited long-format line into its six raw columns
drop dynamic (state d) per-sender objects before the guard/cardinality boundary per recommendations.direct.cribl - reconciliation runs on the static drivers

compute the instance split (source.address for src.* objects, destination.address/port for dst.* objects, raw fallback for filter/parser/global objects) and the stamp-to-epoch-ms conversion - all read the ORIGINAL SourceName/SourceInstance/Type/Number before they are renamed (compute-before-rename)

conf.code: var t = __e['Type']; var num = Number(__e['Number']); if (t === 'queued' && num > 9223372036854775807) { num = num - 18446744073709551616; } __e.syslog_ng = __e.syslog_ng || {}; __e.syslog_ng.stats = __e.syslog_ng.stats || {}; if (t) { __e.syslog_ng.stats[t] = num; }

functions.description: route this line's counter into a typed field named after Type (e.g. syslog_ng.stats.dropped, .processed) rather than a generic name/value pair, clamping the known unsigned-underflow defect on queued - reads the original Type/Number before the batched rename below
batched rename of the six clean raw columns onto the custom namespace, now that every derived field has already read their pre-rename values
stamp the daemon identity (this format has no PROGRAM-equivalent header field, unlike syslog-kv) and set event.dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
